NOTE: Independent/PA (Anna Wise) — inflation cooled in June ahead of energy squeeze. Ofgem cap rose 13% from 1 July (+£221 to £1,862/yr typical bill). VAT cut (Oct 1) est to cut CPI ~0.1ppt. Thomas Pugh (RSM UK): falling oil prices "main drag on inflation in June"; but oil rebounded in July, inflation "still likely to peak at around 3.4% in November." Temporary relief framing.
